title: OBVIL — corpus La Haine du théâtre (querelle du théâtre)
notes: 'La Haine du theatre / querelle du theatre' is an OBVIL corpus of the 17th-century French anti-theatre controversy (1541-1698 texts: adibert_avis_1687, honneur-theatre_1620, etc.), TEI encoded (repo OBVIL/haine-theatre, GitHub Pages edition verified live); the 14 RQ texts match its file namespace exactly. License per ATTRIBUTIONS: CC BY-NC-ND. The main OBVIL site was unreachable at check time; the GitHub Pages edition is the verified entry point.
